تبتسرون (form VIII)
# تَبْتَسِرُونَ (tabtasirūna) /tab.ta.si.ruː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِبْتَسَرَ (ibtasara)
# تُبْتَسَرُونَ (tubtasarūna) /tub.ta.sa.ruː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِبْتَسَرَ (ibtasara)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
